description: BRINGS IN reference from the web, each item its own https URL. Images are downloaded and stored, a title becoming the picture's caption; anything else becomes a link card to the original. Safe to run twice: each card is stamped with its source URL, so a repeat run updates the same cards. dry_run first for a long list. For pictures on the web use this, not upload_image.

draft.description: The draft key create_boards returned. Pass it on every call about that draft.

dry_run.description: Check the list; fetch and create nothing

group.description: The section they go in unless their own group says otherwise (made if missing)

titles.description: Titles by position in urls; left out, from filenames

urls.description: At most 100 https URLs, each a string or {url, title?, group?}

title.description: Its caption; left out, from the filename

name: import_urls
title: Import from URLs
